clean_description: The Big Short explores the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis, focusing on the individuals who predicted the collapse of the housing market and profited from it. Through a mix of personal stories and detailed analysis, it highlights the complexities of the financial instruments that contributed to the crisis. The book sheds light on the systemic failures within financial institutions and regulatory bodies that allowed the crisis to occur.
themes: financial crisis, risk, greed, systemic failure
